name: Usage dashboard
description: The claude-code-usage-stats dashboard's own design system. A dense data surface, not an artifact brand - it carries eight categorical series, a sequential heat scale and a warn triad that an artifact brand would not.

notes.series.ceiling: Eight categorical series, already generous. THEME.md: 'past eight, facet.' Worst-case contrast is --s2 at 4.37:1 against --panel, well clear of the 3:1 mark floor.
notes.status_tokens: The warn triad is reserved and never a series colour. The heat scale is sequential and likewise never categorical, but it is not listed here - status-as-series only checks tokens used AS marks, and --heatN legitimately is one.
notes.forbidden_tokens: Token names from the other systems on this machine. Their appearance means something was pasted in from Casenote or the life-and-times site rather than using this theme's tokens.
notes.impeccable.ignoreRules: Empty, deliberately. Unlike Casenote (which mandates Inter and so must suppress overused-font), this theme uses the system stack and upstream finds nothing to disagree with. Verified: 0 findings on both the template and the rendered 1.75MB dashboard.
